claude-mem.description: Persistent memory across sessions. Runs a local background worker and records your session activity in a local database.
claude-mem.manual: claude-mem starts its background worker on your first session after a restart. Its memory stays on your machine.

fast-jev.description: fast-jev-compaction: compacts long conversations at 40% context. Needs a TypeSafe API key that you set yourself.
fast-jev.manual: fast-jev-compaction needs your own TypeSafe API key: set the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable, or the plugin's apiKey option. Without one, turn it off with: claude plugin disable fast-jev-compaction@fast-jev-compaction. It needs a full Claude Code restart.

unity.description: Unity Technologies' agent plugin (beta). Only useful if you work on Unity projects.
unity.manual: The unity plugin needs a Unity project (and the Unity MCP package) to do anything.

github-mcp.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (issues, PRs, code search). You create a GitHub token and set it as an environment variable yourself.
github-mcp.manual: github-mcp needs a GitHub token that you create and keep yourself. Create one with only the access you want Claude to have (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens), then run this in your own PowerShell window, not in Claude: setx GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN "paste-your-token-here"  and restart Claude Code. This setup never sees or stores the token.

statusline.description: Pace-aware status line from github.com/TheDyXer/claude-statusline (Windows, PowerShell).
statusline.manual: The status line appears after a restart. To update it later, use the update prompt in the claude-statusline README.

model-prefs.description: Default model Sonnet with high-effort settings. Check these match what your plan offers.
model-prefs.manual: model-prefs set Sonnet with xhigh effort as defaults. Change them with /model if your plan doesn't offer them.

advisor.description: Advisor model setting plus a CLAUDE.md rule telling Claude to consult the advisor before multi-step work and before finishing. Needs a plan that includes the advisor.
advisor.manual: The advisor rule assumes the advisor is available. If it isn't on your plan, remove the claude-code-setup block from CLAUDE.md.
